symptom: PC1 cannot ping PC2 in the same department
topology_note: PC1 is on Fa0/1, PC2 is on Fa0/2
show_outputs: SW1# show vlan brief -> Fa0/1 in VLAN 10, Fa0/2 in VLAN 1
expected_fault: Fa0/2 is in the wrong VLAN

symptom: Traffic between Switch 1 and Switch 2 is dropping
show_outputs: SW1# show interfaces trunk -> Vlans allowed: 1-9,20-4094
expected_fault: VLAN 10 is missing from the allowed VLAN list on the trunk
correct_fix: conf t\ninterface gi0/1\nswitchport trunk allowed vlan add 10

symptom: CDP native VLAN mismatch warnings on console
topology_note: SW1 Gi0/1 connected to SW2 Gi0/1
show_outputs: SW1# show interfaces gi0/1 switchport -> Trunking Native Mode VLAN: 99\nSW2# show interfaces gi0/1 switchport -> Trunking Native Mode VLAN: 1
expected_fault: Native VLAN mismatch on trunk link
correct_fix: conf t\ninterface gi0/1\nswitchport trunk native vlan 99

symptom: PC cannot acquire IP from DHCP, port is up
show_outputs: SW1# show vlan brief -> VLAN 20 does not exist. Fa0/10 is inactive
expected_fault: VLAN 20 was deleted from the switch database

symptom: Trunk link between SW1 and SW2 will not form
topology_note: SW1 Gi0/1 connected to SW2 Gi0/1
show_outputs: SW1# show int gi0/1 switchport -> Administrative Mode: dynamic desirable\nSW2# show int gi0/1 switchport -> Administrative Mode: static access
expected_fault: SW2 port configured as static access port instead of trunk or desirable

symptom: Traffic on voice VLAN not reaching IP phone
topology_note: PC daisy-chained behind IP Phone on Fa0/5
show_outputs: SW1# show interfaces fa0/5 switchport -> Voice VLAN: none
expected_fault: Voice VLAN is not configured on the switch access port

symptom: PC cannot ping external server but can ping local router
show_outputs: C:\> ipconfig -> Default Gateway: 192.168.1.254
expected_fault: PC is configured with the wrong default gateway

symptom: Inter-VLAN routing failing for VLAN 30
show_outputs: R1# show ip int brief -> Gi0/0.30 is administratively down
expected_fault: Subinterface for VLAN 30 is shut down

symptom: Host cannot reach subnet 10.0.0.0/24
show_outputs: R1# show ip int brief -> Gi0/1 IP Address 10.0.1.1
expected_fault: Router interface IP is on the wrong subnet

symptom: HSRP failover not working, no gateway reachable
topology_note: R1 and R2 running HSRP group 1
show_outputs: R1# show standby -> Virtual IP is 192.168.1.254\nR2# show standby -> Virtual IP is 192.168.1.250
expected_fault: HSRP Virtual IP mismatch between routers

symptom: Subinterface traffic dropped on Router-on-a-Stick
show_outputs: R1# show run int gi0/0.10 -> encapsulation dot1Q 20
expected_fault: Subinterface VLAN encapsulation tag does not match subnet VLAN 10

symptom: Host in VLAN 10 cannot ping default gateway on Layer 3 switch
show_outputs: CoreSW# show int vlan 10 -> Vlan10 is down, line protocol is down (no ports active in vlan)
expected_fault: SVI Vlan10 is down because no active physical ports exist in VLAN 10
correct_fix:
conf t
interface fa0/10
switchport access vlan 10
no shutdown

symptom: New PCs in VLAN 10 receive 169.254.x.x addresses
topology_note: R1 acts as DHCP server for VLAN 10
show_outputs: R1# show ip dhcp pool -> Total addresses: 50, Leased: 50
expected_fault: DHCP pool is exhausted

symptom: PCs get IP addresses but cannot reach other networks
show_outputs: R1# show run | section dhcp -> ip dhcp pool LAN\n network 10.1.1.0 255.255.255.0
expected_fault: DHCP pool missing default-router option

symptom: Valid DHCP server packets dropped by switch
show_outputs: SW1# show ip dhcp snooping -> Gi0/2 is untrusted
expected_fault: DHCP snooping blocking server because port is untrusted
correct_fix: conf t\ninterface gi0/2\nip dhcp snooping trust

symptom: IP address conflict detected in logs
show_outputs: R1# show run | inc dhcp -> No excluded addresses configured
expected_fault: Gateway IP is being handed out by DHCP

symptom: Clients in VLAN 20 cannot reach remote DHCP server
show_outputs: R1# show run int gi0/0.20 -> interface GigabitEthernet0/0.20 (No helper address)
expected_fault: Missing ip helper-address on router subinterface

symptom: DHCP clients receive lease but cannot resolve external domains
show_outputs: R1# show run | section dhcp -> ip dhcp pool HQ (No dns-server command)
expected_fault: DHCP pool configuration is missing dns-server option

symptom: Router cannot resolve hostnames to IPs when pinging
show_outputs: R1# show run | inc domain-lookup -> no ip domain-lookup
expected_fault: DNS resolution disabled on router

symptom: PC cannot browse internet by name, pings to 8.8.8.8 succeed
show_outputs: C:\> ipconfig /all -> DNS Servers: 127.0.0.1
expected_fault: PC configured with wrong DNS server IP
correct_fix: Update PC DNS server to valid IP (e.g. 8.8.8.8)

symptom: Router ping to server.local fails
show_outputs: R1# show run | inc name-server -> ip name-server 8.8.8.8
expected_fault: Router missing internal DNS server

symptom: DNS queries failing across firewall
show_outputs: R1# show access-lists -> 100 deny udp any any eq 53\n100 permit ip any any
expected_fault: ACL is explicitly dropping DNS traffic
correct_fix:
conf t
ip access-list extended 100
no 10
10 permit udp any any eq 53

symptom: Internal domain queries routed to ISP DNS fail
show_outputs: R1# show run | inc ip domain name -> (missing)
expected_fault: Missing domain lookup default search domain

symptom: Internal network cannot reach the internet
topology_note: R1 connected to ISP via Serial0/0
show_outputs: R1# show ip route -> Gateway of last resort is not set
expected_fault: Missing default static route

symptom: OSPF neighbor not forming on Gi0/1
topology_note: R1 and R2 connected via Gi0/1
show_outputs: R1# show ip ospf interface -> Gi0/1 is up, line protocol is up, No Hellos (Passive interface)
expected_fault: Interface Gi0/1 is configured as passive in OSPF

symptom: R1 does not know route to 10.0.2.0/24 via OSPF
show_outputs: R2# show run | section ospf -> network 10.0.1.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
expected_fault: Network 10.0.2.0 is not advertised into OSPF on R2

symptom: Static route fails to forward traffic
show_outputs: R1# show run | inc route -> ip route 192.168.100.0 255.255.255.0 10.0.0.99 (unreachable)
expected_fault: Next-hop IP for static route is wrong or unreachable

symptom: OSPF adjacency stuck in INIT state
topology_note: R1 Gi0/0 connected to R2 Gi0/0
show_outputs: R1# show ip ospf interface gi0/0 -> Hello 10, Dead 40\nR2# show ip ospf interface gi0/0 -> Hello 5, Dead 20
expected_fault: OSPF Hello and Dead timer mismatch between peers
correct_fix:
conf t
interface gi0/0
ip ospf hello-interval 10
ip ospf dead-interval 40

symptom: OSPF neighbor adjacency dropped due to MTU mismatch
topology_note: R1 Gi0/1 connected to R2 Gi0/1
show_outputs: R1# show ip ospf neighbor -> State: EXSTART\nR1# show int gi0/1 | inc MTU -> MTU 1500 bytes\nR2# show int gi0/1 | inc MTU -> MTU 1400 bytes
expected_fault: Interface MTU mismatch preventing OSPF DBD exchange

symptom: Floating static route taking precedence over OSPF
show_outputs: R1# show run | inc ip route -> ip route 10.5.0.0 255.255.0.0 172.16.1.2 90
expected_fault: Static route administrative distance is 90, which is lower than OSPF AD 110

symptom: VLAN 10 cannot ping VLAN 20, but VLAN 20 can ping VLAN 10
show_outputs: R1# show access-lists 101 -> 10 permit tcp any any eq 80 (No permit ip any any)
expected_fault: Implicit deny at the end of the ACL is dropping ICMP
correct_fix: conf t\nip access-list extended 101\n20 permit ip any any

symptom: Web server inaccessible from internet
show_outputs: R1# show ip int Gi0/1 -> Outgoing access list is 110, Inbound is not set
expected_fault: ACL applied in the wrong direction (outbound instead of inbound)
correct_fix:
conf t
interface gi0/1
no ip access-group 110 out
ip access-group 110 in

symptom: Host A cannot reach Server B; standard ACL blocks entire subnet
show_outputs: R1# show access-lists 10 -> 10 deny 192.168.1.10\n20 permit any
expected_fault: Standard ACL placed too close to source blocks all traffic from Host A
correct_fix: Remove ACL from source router and place near destination

symptom: Specific host cannot be blocked from accessing web server
show_outputs: R1# show access-lists 100 -> 10 permit ip any any\n20 deny ip host 192.168.1.5 host 10.0.0.5
expected_fault: Deny statement placed after permit any any, making it useless
correct_fix:
conf t
ip access-list extended 100
no 10
no 20
10 deny ip host 192.168.1.5 host 10.0.0.5
20 permit ip any any

symptom: SSH management to switch blocked for Admin workstation
show_outputs: SW1# show access-lists 22 -> 10 permit 192.168.1.50 (Admin IP is 192.168.1.60)
expected_fault: Admin host IP is not permitted in VTY access-class ACL

symptom: Established TCP connections dropped upon return
topology_note: Stateful inspection missing on edge ACL
show_outputs: R1# show access-lists 102 -> 10 permit tcp any 192.168.1.0 0.0.0.255 eq 80 (Missing established keyword)
expected_fault: Inbound return traffic blocked without established keyword
correct_fix: conf t\nip access-list extended 102\n10 permit tcp any 192.168.1.0 0.0.0.255 established

symptom: Internal users have no internet access, NAT configured
topology_note: R1 connects LAN on Gi0/0, ISP on Gi0/1
show_outputs: R1# show ip nat statistics -> Outside interfaces: Gi0/0, Inside interfaces: Gi0/1
expected_fault: NAT inside and outside interfaces are swapped
correct_fix:
conf t
int gi0/0
ip nat inside
int gi0/1
ip nat outside

symptom: Only one internal user can access internet at a time
show_outputs: R1# show run | inc nat -> ip nat inside source list 1 interface Gi0/1
expected_fault: Overload keyword is missing for PAT
correct_fix: conf t\nno ip nat inside source list 1 interface Gi0/1\nip nat inside source list 1 interface Gi0/1 overload

symptom: VLAN 20 users cannot access internet, VLAN 10 users can
show_outputs: R1# show access-lists 1 -> 10 permit 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255
expected_fault: NAT ACL does not include VLAN 20 subnet

symptom: Inbound web traffic to internal web server failing
show_outputs: R1# show ip nat translations -> Inside Global: 203.0.113.5, Inside Local: 192.168.1.99
expected_fault: Static NAT entry mapped to incorrect inside local IP address
correct_fix: conf t\nno ip nat inside source static 192.168.1.99 203.0.113.5\nip nat inside source static 192.168.1.80 203.0.113.5

symptom: Laptop cannot associate with corporate SSID
show_outputs: Client logs: WPA2 4-way handshake failed
expected_fault: Pre-shared key (PSK) mismatch on the client
correct_fix: Update the wireless profile on the laptop with the correct PSK

symptom: Guest wireless users have access to internal servers
topology_note: Guest SSID intended for internet only
show_outputs: WLC# show wlan 2 -> Interface: management (VLAN 10)
expected_fault: Guest SSID is mapped to the internal management VLAN
correct_fix: Reconfigure WLAN to map to the isolated Guest VLAN

symptom: Access point fails to join WLC
show_outputs: SW1# show interfaces Fa0/5 switchport -> Operational Mode: static access
expected_fault: Switchport connected to AP is not configured as a trunk

symptom: PC disconnected abruptly; port light is orange/red
show_outputs: SW1# show int fa0/8 -> FastEthernet0/8 is down, line protocol is down (err-disabled)
expected_fault: Port security violation triggered err-disable due to unauthorized MAC address

symptom: High CPU utilization and broadcast radiation across all VLANs
topology_note: Redundant links between SW1, SW2, SW3
show_outputs: SW1# show spanning-tree -> Spanning tree is disabled for VLAN 1
expected_fault: Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) is disabled, causing a Layer 2 switching loop
